''See also: [[Melerius Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Melerius is an ancient [[Archmage]] who serves as the magical advisor to [[Queen Shyrax]]. He possesses specialized soul magic, which allows him to interact with the Aetheric structure of sentient beings. An elderly man with a beard, he has previously served as a magical advisor to the royal guard during one of his many lives. Melerius has been known to exist as a [[spirit]] contained within a [[ring]], allowing him to manifest as a ghostly or intangible presence. He is characterized by a scholarly and inquisitive nature, frequently expressing a desire to learn from powerful individuals and instructing students at the [[Magic Tower]]. He has demonstrated significant insight into magical defenses, Binding magic{{!}}binding magic, and the fundamental nature of spirits.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Melerius manifests as a translucent, white echo of a human [[wizard]]. This ghostly figure possesses a long beard and wears a hooded mantle.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|As an advisor to the crown, he serves [[Queen Shyrax]] and holds admiration for [[Karoshan]] society. He is a seeker of knowledge who desires more lessons from Varic Vallenar{{!}}Captain Vallenar and recognizes the narrator's mastery over seven magics.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|An ancient [[Archmage]], he utilizes magic that allows him to interact with the Aetheric structure of sentient souls. He is a ghostly mage composed of grayish conjurations of the [[Aether]] and has bound a copy of his consciousness to an artifact.}}

{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|Melerius serves as the magical advisor to [[Queen Shyrax]].<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c3">''The Engineer'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c4">''The Engineer'', chapter 4</ref> An [[Archmage]] by rank, he is currently sealed within a [[ring]] where he has bound a copy of his consciousness to the artifact.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c4" /> He is able to manifest from the [[ring]] as an elderly human with a beard.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c4" /> His magic grants him the ability to interact with a sentient being's Aetheric structure, commonly known as the soul.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c4" /> Furthermore, Melerius is capable of recognizing when a narrator has mastered seven different magics.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c5">''The Engineer'', chapter 5</ref>}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|“Magnificent, their efficiency,” Melerius said, speaking through magical vibrations. “I’ve always admired Karoshan society.”<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c7" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|“But not alchemy,” Melerius said with a twinkle in his eye.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c7" />}}
